basic_info.description: 338 Mangels plays it cool  a reimagined 2-level home in the heart of Sunnyside that leans into its mid-century beginnings while elevating them with fresh updates, better light, and a layout that supports easy living. Newly installed south-facing windows brings light across the main living areas, while refinished oak floors and warm, dimmable designer LED lighting carry a sense of quiet calm throughout.  Upstairs, you'll find 2 bedrooms, an updated full bath and a 1/2 bath, along with a just-updated kitchen finished in quartz, oak, and stone with new stainless appliances, cabinetry, and LED-lit open shelving that balances form + function. This level also includes the living + dining rooms and direct access to the backyard.  Downstairs, the legally added 3rd bedroom and full bath come with a 2nd kitchenette, garden access, and full garage-level amenities: a large side-by-side 2-car garage, ample storage, stacked laundry, and a bonus fridgeideal for exuberant Costco runs, extended stays, or entertaining.  Out back, the terraced, fully fenced garden connects both levels and includes spaces for sitting, gathering, and growing herbs, grapes, and vegetables. Just 1/2 a block from Sunnyside Playground, 338 sits near the Conservatory, Glen Park BART, top schools, and 101/280 access.
